r: Segmental division; hierarchy; restrictions on feeding and social intercourse; civil and religious disabilities and privileges; **lack of free choice of occupation**; restrictions on marriage (endogamy)
Enunciated **seven cultural traits** of caste (endogamy, commensal and food restrictions, hereditary occupation, pollution, etc.)
Pollution by touch, untouchability, Sanskritic rituals, commensal taboos
The **varna model** (book view) has produced a **wrong and distorted image of caste** – the real unit is the local **jati**
**4,147** castes; caste enumeration began with the **1871** Census
The **Viramushtis** are bards/beggars dependent on the **Komatis (Vaishyas)**
**Ashraf** (foreign descent, upper-caste converts), **Ajlaf** (clean occupational groups), **Arzal** (lowest; converts from untouchable castes)
From St Thomas (52 AD); about 74% identify with lower castes
Tribe and caste as poles of a **continuum** (*Tribe, Caste and Nation*, 1960)
